title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
summary: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.
reason: Signal limiting screenshots is a messaging app UI/product feature change, not an AI model release, research artifact, AI business event (financing/M&A/partnership/market data/product launch), policy action, or open-source AI tool. No active rule covers it.
